masters.name: Neutral slide master
masters.description: The starter deck geometry at 1280 by 720: twelve hand-tuned archetypes and the layout library structures expanded in the same margins, every box a fraction of the slide, colours named as design-system token paths so a brand that is imported over the blank starter takes the whole master with it. No brand decoration, because a colourless starter has no brand hues to draw with.
